titleEn: Minimum Number of Days to Eat N Oranges
title: 吃掉 N 个橘子的最少天数
summary: 每天可吃一个橘子，或在数量被二/三整除时分别吃掉一半/三分之二，求吃完最少天数。
insight: 选择除二前需先用 n%2 天吃到二的倍数，再用一天执行除法；除三同理。递归只进入 n/2、n/3，状态数量对数级。
pitfalls: 除法操作本身也耗一天

solutions.title: 除法余数记忆化
solutions.idea: 把逐个吃的天数压缩为到最近可整除数量的余数。

code.java: class Solution { private final Map<Integer,Integer> memo=new HashMap<>();public int minDays(int n){if(n<=1)return n;if(memo.containsKey(n))return memo.get(n);int answer=1+Math.min(n%2+minDays(n/2),n%3+minDays(n/3));memo.put(n,answer);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private val memo=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();fun minDays(n:Int):Int{if(n<=1)return n;return memo.getOrPut(n){1+minOf(n%2+minDays(n/2),n%3+minDays(n/3))}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { unordered_map<int,int> memo;public:int minDays(int n){if(n<=1)return n;if(memo.count(n))return memo[n];return memo[n]=1+min(n%2+minDays(n/2),n%3+minDays(n/3));} };
